summary: Owner-resolution UX is human-readable, but other Eve reconciliation statuses still leak raw enums in Mission Control.
inspection_summary: Inspected owner resolution payloads, Mission Control rendering, failure and mismatch states, and E2E operator-surface assertions.
judgment_delta: Owner behavior passes, but raw status and reason enums must be mapped before the human-usability review can pass.

findings.detail: Mission Control renders no_candidate_call, awaiting_candidates_after_note, candidate_writeback_failed, and related machine values without human-readable labels.
